what: `du` counts a clone's blocks once a file: the store's `placed/*.derived` files read as 450 MB and hold 9.6 MB of their own, so a home's `du` total can be several times what it holds, and the script every lane was given (`/tmp/blaze-fresh.sh`) reports `du`.
cost: one wrong conclusion nearly drawn (that the store had tripled)
cause: `du` has no notion of shared extents
workaround: wrote a script that asks `ATTR_CMNEXT_PRIVATESIZE` per file (`/private/tmp/blaze-disk-scripts/private.py`, gone with the lane)
state: open: the measuring script should say private bytes beside `du`'s
